Accessing SHIELD folders on PC using USB
USB port 1 is now configured for SHIELD to connect to a PC as a media device.\n\nThis port will no longer detect USB storage media or USB accessories and cannot be used for charging devices.
In this mode, the USB port is not functional for other uses
